login.title: Login
login.description: Enter your email or username and password to authenticate with an existing account. Authenticating is required to perform actions on this service.

signup.title: Create Account
signup.description: Create an account by providing an email, a username and a password. You will need these credentials to log in to your account later.

description.initial: If you forgot the password to your account, enter the email address of your account below. A message with a link to reset the password fo your account will b sent to that email address.
description.sent: A link that allows you to reset your password was sent to your email address.

description.reset: Your password was reset. You can now log in to your account using the new password.

description.sent: A verification message was sent to your email address {{email}}. Please confirm it by clicking the link in the email.
description.initial: You need to verify your email address {{email}} to access this system. Please request a verification email below and click the link provided in the message.

description.success: Your email address was verified. You can now use your account.
description.failure: The link you used may have been expired or ill-formed. Please try again.

change_conversation_name.title: Edit name
change_conversation_name.description: To change the name of the conversation, enter the new name below.

generic.timeout: Times out while trying to reach the server
generic.permission: You don't have permission to perform that action
generic.authentication: Your identity could not be authenticated
